name: Dr. H. M. Jorgens
role: Medora druggist and merchant from Spearfish; Cave Hills rancher
bio: Dr. H. M. Jorgens came from Spearfish in the Black Hills, and in May 1884 the paper reported that he and Dr. J. M. Louthan had decided to set up business in Medora. In August 1884 he promised to return with a stock of drugs, and in September he toured the Deadwood stage route with Vic Smith. A burned range kept him in Spearfish that fall while he found winter feed for his cattle, but by early 1885 he had brought his wife and sons to Medora from the Cave Hills. In April 1885 he put up a new building for his drug store, and he also sold stationery, notions, jewelry and fancy goods. In December 1885 he started a gift enterprise for customers, and when he received fresh vaccine the paper urged everyone to be vaccinated. Through 1885 and 1886 he made regular trips to Spearfish and to his Cave Hills ranch, where he hauled supplies in July 1886.
